# L488784d8 vectors, set family `_CANR`: swing_atr_0.25 + trig_momentum_roc / break_native {'len': 20, 'wd': 1.0} (NY AM)

**RULE: RUN MERGE (consecutive same price + same side, no gap condition), side = last-vs-bid/ask (last>=ask buy, last<=bid sell, else 0), merged print stamped with its FIRST record's time. REFERENCE ONLY: the bar close time is earlier than the time the run is known complete (look-ahead, optimistic by the run-completion delay). Relay builder name: 'CANQ'.**

**Set suffix: `_CANR`** (sets TL3_ALN_NY_L488784d8_CANR). Set families and what each used: `_CAN` = records merged on the same millisecond + side (tape flag) + price, ms-truncated stamps (superseded); `_CANQ` = contract-level prints (each contract one print), side last-vs-bid/ask (superseded, reference); `_CANR` = run merge + last-vs-bid/ask, first-record stamp (look-ahead, reference); `_CANC` = run merge + last-vs-bid/ask, causal close (next different print); `_CANG` = 1 s-cap run merge, causal close.

Prices in points, times UTC. Threshold: daily value as in D8_BAR_DEFS.md / d8_vectors_md (volume/range scales do not depend on the split). Rule text: D8_PRINT_RULE.md. One row per bar: close time and values together.
